scenes.title: Welcome to DemoStudio
scenes.text: Let me show you Demo Studio by using the real application. It helps you turn a working app into a narrated video you can send to testers, without asking them to install the app first.
scenes.action: Show the actual DemoStudio opening screen.

scenes.title: Create a project
scenes.text: Here, I'm preparing the SoHelpMe demonstration. I load its project, which gives the video a name, keeps the application address handy, and brings in the scene plan. You can save that project and reuse it later.
scenes.action: Load examples/SoHelpMe.json through the real project loader.

scenes.title: Prepare the story
scenes.text: Each scene says what to show, what to say, and how long to allow. I review the refrigerator story here. The script describes what the actual app does, including the observation about two bottles touching.
scenes.action: Expand the actual scene editor and show its text fields.

scenes.title: Generate the narration
scenes.text: Next, I use free Piper narration, right on this computer. No Microsoft service, subscription, or API key is needed. Demo Studio measures the speech for caption timing. Listen before continuing. I've shortened the processing wait here.
scenes.action: Show the actual generation request and the actual successful audio preview.

scenes.title: Bring in the real screen recording
scenes.text: You can capture an application tab, or import an existing screen recording. I'm importing the real SoHelpMe interaction we just recorded. The preview lets me check the picture before I create the finished video.
scenes.action: Import the genuine SoHelpMe screen recording and play the source preview.

scenes.title: Check the picture
scenes.text: This is the point to check framing and private details. Optional crop controls and fixed black masks are available. Once the picture looks right, I confirm the preview and continue.
scenes.action: Show the real privacy controls and confirm the preview.

scenes.title: Create and export
scenes.text: Now I create the narrated preview. Demo Studio combines the recording, spoken narration, and captions into an MP4 on this computer. After reviewing it, I choose Export MP4 to save the finished file.
scenes.action: Create a real MP4 preview and use the actual Export MP4 button.

scenes.title: See the resulting SoHelpMe video
scenes.text: Here is the resulting SoHelpMe video playing inside Demo Studio. It contains the real refrigerator conversation, practical replies, Piper narration, and captions. You can watch the separate MP4 at full size and share it with testers.
scenes.action: Play the actual exported SoHelpMe MP4.

scenes.title: Use it for your next application
scenes.text: For ThinkAgain or Waiting Room Buddy, start another project, change the app address and story, then capture or import its real workflow. Generate the narration, review the result, and export. Your next demonstration uses the same process.
scenes.action: Show the reusable project settings after completing the real SoHelpMe export.
